notes: Several claims are true to the source but absent from the deep ref (RLS page length, the full eleven-question Part 3 list, Appendix C's dissemination, punishment and litigation questions, the DO's SAP follow-up duty, 'Safety is in the entire system'). They are graded MINOR-DRIFT as re-extractions, not UNSUPPORTED; the right fix is to add Appendix C's DO questions and the Part 11 SAP sentence to the deep ref so these have an audited anchor. Real errors: 'five categories' where the source has four (line 34); the HRO-vs-AAR effectiveness claim (line 54), where the source instead reserves HRO questions for participants already familiar with the traits; a quoted phrase in the worked example found nowhere in the source (line 157); and two integration rows that attribute to OpenStax OB and Psychology 2e content their deep refs do not hold (anchoring; RPD; bounded rationality in Psych 2e). Cosmetic: line 36 doubles the [V] marker inside the citation parentheses. The worked example is hypothetical and presents no outcome as the source's finding. Checked and faithful: NHS (nhs deep 7), Barbrook-Johnson & Penn seven methods (bj deep 3, 7), Field Guide's Prime Directive (ap field guide deep 218).
